description: Impact pile driving for WTG and OSS foundations is prohibited from January 1 to April 30.
context_quote: Impact pile driving must not occur January 1 through April 30.

description: Impact pile driving for WTG and OSS foundations should be avoided in December.
context_quote: Impact pile driving must be avoided to the maximum extent practicable in December

description: Monopiles must be no larger than 11 meters in diameter.
context_quote: Monopiles must be no larger than 11 m in diameter

description: Maximum hammer energy for monopile installation must not exceed 4,000 kilojoules.
context_quote: Hammer energies must not exceed 4,000 kilojoules for monopile installation.

description: No more than two monopiles may be installed per day.
context_quote: No more than two monopiles may be installed per day.

description: Pin piles must be no larger than 5 meters in diameter.
context_quote: Pin piles must be no larger than 5 m in diameter.

description: Maximum hammer energy for pin pile installation must not exceed 2,500 kilojoules.
context_quote: Hammer energies must not exceed 2,500 kJ for pin pile installation.

description: No more than three pin piles may be installed per day.
context_quote: No more than three pin piles may be installed per day.

description: Impact pile driving may occur during hours of darkness from June 1 to October 31.
context_quote: LOA Holder may initiate impact pile driving during hours of darkness only from June 1 to October 31, annually

description: In May and November (and December with NMFS approval), impact pile driving must be initiated during daylight hours.
context_quote: For the construction months of May and November (as well as December, if approval is granted by NMFS), impact pile driving must only be initiated during daylight hours

description: A soft-start protocol must be used for each impact pile driving event.
context_quote: LOA Holder must utilize a soft-start protocol for each impact pile driving event of all foundations

description: Soft-start must involve 4-6 strikes per minute at 10-20 percent of maximum hammer energy for at least 20 minutes.
context_quote: by performing four to six strikes per minute at 10 to 20 percent of the maximum hammer energy, for a minimum of 20 minutes

description: Soft-start must occur at the beginning of impact driving and after any cessation of 30 minutes or longer.
context_quote: Soft-start must occur at the beginning of impact driving and at any time following a cessation of impact pile driving of 30 minutes or longer

description: A single bubble curtain must not be used.
context_quote: A single bubble curtain must not be used

description: Bubble curtain(s) must distribute air bubbles using an air flow rate of at least 0.5 m^3/(minute*m).
context_quote: Any bubble curtain(s) must distribute air bubbles using an air flow rate of at least 0.5 m [3] /(minute*m).

description: PAM system components must not be placed closer than 1 km to the pile being driven.
context_quote: The PAM system components ( *i.e.,* acoustic buoys) must not be placed closer than 1 km to the pile being driven

description: All vessels must maintain a speed of 10 knots or less within any active North Atlantic right whale Slow Zone.
geographic_scope: North Atlantic right whale Slow Zone
context_quote: All LOA Holder's vessels must transit at 10 kn or less within any active North Atlantic right whale Slow Zone

description: Vessels must maintain a minimum separation distance of 500 meters from North Atlantic right whales.
context_quote: LOA Holder's vessels must maintain a minimum separation distance of 500 m from North Atlantic right whales.
